name: music-desktop
description: Navidrome and the music frontend packaged as one desktop app

scripts.test: node --test contracts.test.js control-relay.test.js music-store.test.js history.test.js player.test.js music-folders.test.js sign-mac.test.js portable-linux.test.js service-lifecycle.test.js main.test.js profiles.test.js && node --experimental-strip-types --test ../frontend/tests/*.test.ts
scripts.dev:hot: pnpm build:preload && sh -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT; (cd ../frontend && MUSIC_HMR_PORT=5183 exec pnpm exec vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5183 --strictPort) & MUSIC_DEV_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:5183 electron .'
scripts.dist: pnpm prepare:build && pnpm navidrome && pnpm build:preload && pnpm build:frontend && electron-builder --config builder-config.json --linux --publish never && pnpm pack:portable
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm navidrome && pnpm build:frontend && pnpm pack:mac:dir && pnpm pack:mac && pnpm pack:portable
scripts.pack:mac:dir: pnpm prepare:build && pnpm build:preload && node scripts/package-mac.mjs --dir
scripts.dev:app: pnpm navidrome && pnpm build:preload && pnpm build:frontend && node scripts/repo-app.mjs
